decision: 2026-11-03, Sam approved the proposal in the ERP CI analysis chat for fixture commit 997499e3 and blob 381485af13b0f207ffb910dc7af5b2b19ef04bfc with the exact response "批准此版本進入既有四片 CI".
purpose: Reuse the pristine schema through migration 0088 in the existing Sales/Fulfillment fixture for functional server coverage. Every fixture still owns its own UUID database, connections and cleanup. The first fixture in a test-file process captures the migrated baseline before case data or fault injection.
data: Existing framework schema, migration seeds and ledger. Same synthetic case data, row counts and fault scenarios. One in-memory logical dump per participating test-file process and one restore into each subsequent fresh database.
concurrency: Four existing independent MySQL server shards. Existing serial file execution and case-level transaction concurrency.
repetitions: Existing single execution of each selected functional case. Zero new cases, repetitions, CI workers, jobs or scheduled runs.
thresholds: All existing functional and rollback assertions. Server coverage lines/branches/functions 92/83/90 percent, original per-file floors, client coverage and aggregate/evidence gates. Observe natural PR first results against mean <= 10 minutes and maximum <= 15 minutes.
trigger: Existing routine functional server coverage on admitted PR, main, schedule and functional dispatch. No capacity workload, workflow or trigger change.
cost: One logical dump for the first fixture per test-file process, subsequent fixtures restore the baseline. End-to-end savings and CI critical path remain unmeasured. No additional jobs; estimated incremental public standard-runner compute charge US$0.

cases: Existing Sales/Fulfillment functional integration families using salesFulfillmentFixture directly or via aggregate, lifecycle and P1 fixtures. No new registrations.
